title: Scroll of Ice Knife

sources.title: Scrolls
markers: A character of any class can cast

fields.Cast: Level 1. Spend an Action and consume the scroll. No spell slot required.
fields.Effect: Ranged spell attack for 1d10 Piercing. The shard then explodes for 2d6 Cold in a 7 ft radius on a failed Dexterity save, even if the first attack missed. Leaves Ice for 2 turns. A successful save negates only the Cold burst. The initial Piercing hit uses its own attack roll.
fields.Scroll rules: Any class can cast this in BG3 if able to cast spells. Applicable attack rolls and saves use your proficiency bonus and item spellcasting ability. A Counterspelled scroll is not consumed.

changes: Added exact native BG3 scroll activation, spell mechanics, and shared item-casting rules from pinned sources. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
